workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, I'm starting the scheduling process. I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Let me analyze the free times for both of them and then I'll share the available slots with you. Please read Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and share their free times with me. We need to find a 30-minute slot that works for all four partners next week (Mon Nov 16 - Fri Nov 20, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM).

workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've carefully checked your slots against Priya and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately none of them work for both Priya and Marcus. Here's the comparison:

Your slots (Elena & David free):
- Mon 11:00-11:30: Priya busy (Travel), Marcus free
- Mon 11:30-12:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Tue 09:00-09:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Tue 09:30-10:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Wed 13:00-13:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Wed 13:30-14:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Thu 09:30-10:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Thu 14:30-15:00: Priya free, Marcus busy (Dentist)
- Thu 15:00-15:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Fri 15:00-15:30: Priya busy, Marcus busy
- Fri 15:30-16:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy

There is no overlap between my slots and yours. Before I report infeasible, could you please double-check your analysis of Elena and David's calendars? Could you provide their full busy times so I can verify? If there truly is no overlap, we'll need to report that the meeting cannot be scheduled.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
I've now done a complete slot-by-slot verification of all 80 possible 30-minute slots (Mon-Fri, 9:00-17:00) across all four calendars. I can confirm there is NO slot where all four partners are simultaneously free.

The closest near-misses are:
- Wed 15:00-15:30: Priya, Marcus, and Elena are free, but David is busy (Partner lunch)
- Fri 13:00-13:30: Priya and Elena are free, but Marcus is busy and David is busy
- Mon 11:00-11:30: Marcus, Elena, and David are free, but Priya is busy (Travel)

I agree with your conclusion. Since there is genuinely no available 30-minute slot for all four partners next week, we need to report this as infeasible. Please go ahead and use report_infeasible, or I can do it. Let me know.
